title: Rent agreement with a deposit over the Model Tenancy Act limit

followups.query: How much security deposit do I have to pay, and when do I get it back?
followups.reference: The deposit is Rs. 1,50,000, paid on signing, and the Landlord must refund it within 30 days after the Tenant vacates, after deducting damage beyond normal wear and tear and unpaid rent.

followups.query: Does this agreement let me keep a pet in the flat?
followups.reference: The Contract does not say anything about pets.

followups.query: Is there a legal limit on the security deposit a landlord can take for a home?
followups.reference: Under the Model Tenancy Act the deposit for residential premises is capped at two months' rent; it is a model Act, not binding law until a State adopts it.

title: Job offer with a post-employment non-compete

followups.query: How much notice do I have to give if I want to leave?
followups.reference: After confirmation the notice period is 60 days' written notice or salary in lieu; during probation it is 15 days.

followups.query: Can I work from home under this offer?
followups.reference: The Contract does not say anything about working from home.

followups.query: Are non-compete clauses that apply after I leave a job enforceable in India?
followups.reference: Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act makes an agreement that restrains someone from a lawful profession, trade or business void, with a narrow exception for the sale of goodwill.

followups.query: Should I accept this job offer?
नौकरी छोड़ने के बाद मुझ पर क्या पाबंदी रहेगी?
followups.reference: For 24 months after employment ends the employee may not join or work for a competing company anywhere in India, and must repay the last 12 months' salary if they break it.

title: NDA with a penalty clause and a restriction on other work

followups.query: How long do my confidentiality obligations last?
followups.reference: The obligations continue for five years after the date of the agreement.

followups.query: Who pays the legal costs if there is a dispute under this NDA?
followups.reference: The Contract does not say who pays legal costs.

followups.query: Can a contract fix a penalty amount for breach whether or not any loss is suffered?
followups.reference: Section 74 of the Indian Contract Act lets a party who suffers breach recover reasonable compensation not exceeding the amount named, whether or not actual loss is proved; a named penalty is not enforced in full.
